case_name: In Re vs Amrit Pal Singh Bedi on 16 December, 2020

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Summy Bhasin and Sumit Bhasin (w/o Guneet Bhasin and s/o Ajit Singh Bhasin)

facts_of_case: The complainant, respondent in the present revision petition, filed a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. The case is about investment and non-return of principal amount with interest.

legal_principles.principle: In quasi-criminal cases under Section 138 of the NI Act, no hyper-technical aspects should be taken into consideration.

legal_principles.principle: The complainant's locus standi should not be challenged in quasi-criminal cases.
legal_principles.held: It was urged that the authority letter by Smt. Rupinder Kaur Bedi authorizing Amrit Pal Singh Bedi to file complaint case under Section 138 of the NI Act on her behalf, which is admittedly 'Annexure C-11' with the complaint

outcome.final_order: The petitioners' revisionist have been summoned to face trial on cognizance taken by the Court under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act.
